Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Utkal University Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Utkal University Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date for application for the Project Assistant position at Utkal University is 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they meet the eligibility criteria before attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The required qualification for the Project Assistant post is an M.Sc. Degree in Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks. Ensure you have the necessary academic background before applying.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a salary of Rs. 12,000 per month. This is a contractual role with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Utkal University office, located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, with the pincode 751004. Please check the official notification for the exact venue and timing.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, and self-attested photocopies. If applicable, carry experience certificates and category certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Assistant position at Utkal University. You can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant post in this recruitment drive by Utkal University. Interested candidates should ensure they meet all the requirements.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant role will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Assistant position at Utkal University is Contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the project requirements.
